newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa off highs after rise peters out.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa off highs after rise peters out.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures ended off highs after an early lift given by trade buying petered out, traders said.
Active May last traded 13 stg up at 886 stg, having reached a high of 893 stg. Volume on May was 2,390 lots, of a total 9,595. The volume had been bumped up by crosses, traders said.
The early rise followed a dive to 18-month lows on Thursday. Traders felt that the rise did not have enough substance to be sustained into afternoon trading.
"It went up a bit too fast," one said. "Some people had thought it might go over 900 stg on May but it didn't get anywhere near it." There was no follow through, he said.
There had been some price fixing, but not the amount of position squaring which might normally be seen on a Friday, he said.
He noted also that origin sellers had backed away from the market.
